rationale: The ui.js emitter now lowers a captured theme-painted range, checkbox or radio (native_theme verdict native) onto RangeSlider / Checkbox in the chromium_refresh skin with the HTML state the native and baked C++ lanes already apply from the shared ua_form_control_state() parse, and records each node's captured snapped paint rect, through new or widened WidgetBridge setters (setUaSkin, setCheckboxKind, setCapturedPaintRect; setAccentColor and setRadioGroup reach Checkbox). This brings one emitter into line with the others; Chromium stays the only oracle and Skia/Dawn the renderer, so no design-import, Chromium, rendering, or packaging authority moves.
